failure.result: Historical failure: 19 assertion failures; the vector executable returned non-zero. The same focused target passes locally after the correction below.
assertionGroups: AC1021 TABLECONTENT: omitted content-format CMC and cell-style CMCs must remain semantically incomplete.
AC1021 TABLECONTENT: skipping complete styled borders must preserve alignment.
AC1024 TABLE: preserve the validated entity prefix while withholding incomplete or multi-content TABLECONTENT; distinguish a null DATALINK from malformed handle encoding.
AC1024 TABLE: withhold incomplete cell semantics for value-unit types 3, 5, 12, 16, 32, 65536, -1, and 2147483647.
AC1024 TABLE: kUnknown must withhold typed content without advancing the public body cursor into the optional content.
AC1024 TABLE: inverted, out-of-bounds, and overlapping merged ranges must withhold typed content and preserve cursor rollback.

behavior: AC1024 inline TABLECONTENT that parses but has incomplete semantics now leaves the validated entity prefix committed and rolls body/string/handle cursors back to the optional-content boundary.
Null references with no target are accepted as null while non-null references still require the exact expected handle role.
TABLECONTENT cell-style border payloads are read conditionally by ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.101.4 override bits; unknown override bits fail closed.
The generated sparse-border vector now encodes only the fields selected by its 0x22 lineweight/double-spacing override mask.
sourceEvidence: ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.97 defines TABLECONTENT rows, cells, contents, attributes, and trailing fields.
ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.99 limits documented unit types to 0, 1, 2, 4, and 8; other scalar values remain semantically incomplete.
ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.101.4 places border fields under property-override bits: type 0x01, color 0x08, lineweight 0x02, linetype 0x04, invisibility 0x10, and double spacing 0x20.
ODA v5.4.1 §2.13 defines typed handle relation codes and their counters; the shared bounded-role helper in this source accepts zero-target null references without relaxing non-null role validation.

The sparse-border vector also emitted fields not selected by its mask; it now follows ODA's conditional field order.
